Every returned cudatensor records actual stage: provenance table one row per stage: requested_device caller’s policy ("cpu", "cuda", "auto", "fixed-cpu", "inherited"); device stage actually computed; backend names implementation, base torch; selection_reason explains resolution; fallback true automatic request selected CPU; output_device stage placed result. infer output location device. transfer hybrid operation can compute one device return data another.
code: left_source <- matrix(   1:6,   nrow = 2,   dimnames = list(     sample = c("sample_a", "sample_b"),     feature = c("gene_a", "gene_b", "gene_c")   ) ) right_source <- matrix(   seq_len(6) / 10,   nrow = 3,   dimnames = list(     feature = c("gene_a", "gene_b", "gene_c"),     component = c("component_1", "component_2")   ) )  left <- cuda_tensor(left_source, device = "cpu", dtype = "float64") right <- cuda_tensor(right_source, device = "cpu", dtype = "float64") product <- tensor_matmul(left, right)  tensor_device(product) #>  device backend  #>   "cpu"  "base" to_cpu(product) #>           component #> sample     component_1 component_2 #>   sample_a         2.2         4.9 #>   sample_b         2.8         6.4 construction_provenance <- cuda_provenance(left) construction_provenance #> <cuda_provenance schema=cudaverse-stage/1 stages=1 compute=cpu> #>                   stage requested_device device backend selection_reason #>  tensor_materialization              cpu    cpu    base     explicit_cpu #>  fallback output_device #>     FALSE           cpu  product_provenance <- cuda_provenance(product) product_provenance #> <cuda_provenance schema=cudaverse-stage/1 stages=1 compute=cpu> #>            stage requested_device device backend selection_reason fallback #>  matrix_multiply        inherited    cpu    base inherited_device    FALSE #>  output_device #>            cpu  attr(product_provenance, "schema") #> [1] "cudaverse-stage/1" attr(product_provenance, "compute_device") #> [1] "cpu"

title: Backend selection and compute provenance
text: cudatensr uses dense storage. payload alone approximately prod(shape) * bytes_per_value, outputs temporary tensors. CPU fallback uses ordinary R vectors, physical storage differs torch: CPU float32 values rounded IEEE single precision stored public operation, base R kernels accumulate double precision. CUDA kernels compute native torch dtype. Results therefore compared explicit tolerance rather expected bit--bit identical. Floating tensors may contain IEEE Inf, -Inf, NaN; integer tensors reject values represented exactly. Creating CUDA tensor R object transfers dense input host memory GPU memory. to_cpu(), .array(), .matrix() materialize complete result host memory. Mixed-device binary operations move right operand left operand’s device. CUDA subsetting replacement currently make CPU round trip; matrix arithmetic, broadcasting, reductions, reshape, transpose use tensor’s backend. Large operations can temporarily require input, output, intermediate allocations . package currently provide --core execution automatic chunking. Printing tensor 100 values shows metadata without copying full CUDA allocation; explicitly call to_cpu() transfer intended.

code: library(cudatensr)  x <- cuda_tensor(matrix(1:6, 2, 3)) y <- cuda_tensor(matrix(1:6, 3, 2))  tensor_device(x) to_cpu(tensor_matmul(x, y)) to_cpu(x + 0.5) to_cpu(tensor_mean(x, dim = 1))  reshaped <- tensor_reshape(cuda_tensor(1:12), c(3, 4)) reshaped[1:2, 2:4, drop = FALSE] t(reshaped) named_matrix <- matrix(   1:6,   nrow = 2,   dimnames = list(     sample = c("sample_a", "sample_b"),     feature = c("gene_a", "gene_b", "gene_c")   ) )  tensor <- cuda_tensor(named_matrix) dimnames(to_cpu(tensor)) if (cuda_available()) {   x_gpu <- cuda_tensor(matrix(rnorm(1e6), 1000), device = "cuda") }

title: cudatensr 0.2.0
text: Added cuda_diagnostics() strict, classed device selection cuda_select_device(). Automatic CPU selection now records CUDA selected; explicit CUDA request never silently falls back. Added shared cudaverse-stage/1 provenance contract. cuda_stage() lets extensions record stages, cuda_provenance() reports requested, actual, backend, fallback, output-device metadata consistently. Tensor construction public tensor operations now identify actual compute stage. CUDA subsetting replacement report CPU round trip hybrid execution. CPU float32 tensor storage now rounds IEEE single-precision values instead retaining unquantized doubles float32 label. Base R kernels still accumulate double precision rounding output; CUDA kernels use native torch dtype. Floating tensors consistently preserve IEEE Inf, -Inf, NaN values across construction derived arithmetic. Integer tensors continue reject values exact integer representation.

title: cudatensr 0.1.2
text: Matrix array dimnames now retained backend-independent metadata construction, CPU/CUDA transfer, compatible arithmetic broadcasting, reductions, transpose, matrix multiplication. Conflicting labels paired dimensions fail clearly instead producing mislabeled result.

title: cudatensr 0.1.1
text: Added standard R subsetting replacement methods, tensor_reshape(), t(), .matrix() tensors can manipulated without reaching internal storage. Printing large tensor now reports metadata without implicitly materializing entire object CPU. display threshold controlled options(cudatensr.max_print = 100). Added natural element-wise tensor arithmetic %*% dispatch trailing-dimension broadcasting. Added explicit mixed-dtype promotion. Integer arithmetic, reductions, matrix products now promote safely instead truncating fractions silently overflowing NA. Explicit lossy conversion integer dtype now fails clearly.
